_info: Stufe 1.5b - Zufallsvariation der Greifszene, gelesen von g1sim/randomization.py.
enabled schaltet eine Gruppe an oder aus. Einzelne Zahl = +- Halbbreite um den Normalwert, Liste = [min, max].
Laengen in m, Winkel in Grad, Farben RGB 0..1, Rauschen RGB in Graustufen 0..255.
distractors: only scenes with a distractor pool (volleyball) - count [min, max] of them on the table, keepout_m = gap to ball and basket.
scenes: per scene, narrower ranges laid over the groups above (any key of a group except enabled). volleyball: ball + stand offset
+-0.10 m - the two-hand teacher reaches 20/20 up to ~11 cm, beyond that the far-left starts fail (2026-10-08, 67 --vary objects).
